fusions.name: Rind Gnaw
fusions.desc: A quick gnaw that deals 3 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Cornered Squeak
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A lunge that deals 18 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Under the Skirting
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you 70% later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. You restore 14 health when you cast it.

fusions.name: Hoarded Scraps
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%. You also regenerate 0.8 health a second, permanently.
